citizen.name: Liora Stern
citizen.learned: Liora discovered her passion for glassblowing during her travels along the coast, learning the craft from a reclusive artisan.
citizen.lifestyle: Liora spends her mornings collecting sea glass on the beach and her afternoons creating delicate glass sculptures in her workshop.
citizen.currently: Liora is searching for a space to set up her glassblowing studio and display her creations.

relationships: Liora and Mara bonded over their shared love of the sea and its mysteries.
Liora and Sable often discuss the interplay between light and glass, and how it relates to the mysterious lights at sea.
